about: AI usage that TokenTracker cannot see, kept by hand. .github/scripts/ai_usage_card.py adds each day's tokens and cost on top of the TokenTracker numbers (totals, this month, daily grid, tools, models); the leaderboard rank is left as TokenTracker's. tokens = input + output + cache creation + cache read. estimated_tokens / estimated_cost_usd are the part of that day's figures that is an estimate, not a measurement.

method.measured: 139,074,049 tokens / $92.08, read from the usage records of 14 sessions (the main chat, 5 channel chats and 8 task threads, this update among them) and this update's 2 helpers. Cost is each session's own running total.
method.estimated: 107,873,291 tokens / $80.09 for 5 task threads and 4 channel chats whose usage could not be read, 2 task turns still running, and the rest of this update. Each unread thread is the average of the 6 finished threads that were measured (11.93M tokens, $9.81), each unread chat the average of 5 measured chats (6.08M tokens, $2.95).
